title: Documentation support (MEAT) for chronic conditions
question: Which chronic condition, if any, is supported for risk adjustment by this note? Ignore the reason for the visit. Choose 'no code' if none is supported.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for persistent joint pain.

HPI
The patient is an 89-year-old woman who presents today for evaluation of worsening bilateral knee pain. She reports that the pain has increased over the last three months, particularly when walking long distances or climbing stairs. She describes the sensation as a dull ache that occasionally sharpens with movement. She denies any recent falls, fever, or localized swelling. She notes that she is managing the discomfort with over-the-counter analgesics but seeks a more formal evaluation of her mobility.

Medication List
Lisinopril 10mg daily
Furosemide 20mg daily
Acetaminophen 500mg as needed

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented. She appears in no acute distress. Physical exam reveals mild tenderness to palpation over the bilateral patellofemoral joints. Range of motion is preserved but limited by discomfort. No erythema or warmth is noted. Gait is steady.

Assessment
1. Osteoarthritis of the knees.

Plan
1. Continue current analgesic regimen as needed.
2. Physical therapy referral for strengthening exercises.
3. Follow up in 4 weeks to monitor progress.

Problem List
1. chronic systolic heart failure (HFrEF)
2. Osteoarthritis of the knees
explanations: Heart failure appears only in a problem list and is not addressed in this encounter, so it is not supported for this date of service.

distractors.why: A problem-list entry alone does not show the condition affected care at this visit.
